title: Scam
body: I pressed that I wanted the 5.49$ week trial and they first took 5,49$ than 29$ and again 29$. So please don’t get this app!!!
author: Katrín Eir

title: This app is a money scam!!!
body:
Please do not download this app!! I tried to unsubscribe and still kept getting charged for months even after contacting and deleteing the account!
There is no “money back” policy unless you do a 5 step program of constantly using the app and in no ither circumstance!
This is just to collect your money and trap you in a loophole of spending money on something that won’t help
author: Hekla Rán
